transport: POST /api/v1/events (sendBeacon, fire-and-forget). Server increments daily aggregate counters; no raw event log is kept.
global_rules: No cookies, no localStorage identifiers, no fingerprinting, no IP storage (IP used in memory only for rate limiting).
No free text except 'query' on search_zero_results and search_submitted (normalised, lowercased, trimmed, max 80 chars, emails/phone-number patterns redacted to [redacted]).
Properties not listed here are dropped server-side.
Bots: drop requests with known bot user-agents; Cloudflare bot score where available.
Small samples: dashboards hide any dimension value with fewer than 5 counts in the period.

Helper events (V2.5) may carry the helper slug and stage number because helper pages are public content pages. A helper slug is never joined with an identity, sector, label or visitor. The 'for someone' label never leaves the device.

V2.6: events from a signed-in user are still counted anonymously in event_counts. User-linked activity used for recommendations and trending is a separate store (db/0002 `activity`), never mixed with these counters, kept 90 days, and written only after the user consents (24 §7).

events.name: search_submitted
events.when: User submits a query (Enter, search button, or chooses an example query).

events.name: search_zero_results
events.when: A submitted search returns zero results after the OR fallback.

events.name: filter_applied
events.when: A facet value is added or removed.

events.name: search_result_opened
events.when: User opens a result from search results or suggestions.

events.name: content_viewed
events.when: A content detail page is shown (once per page load).

events.name: official_link_clicked
events.when: User clicks the official-site link of a tool.

events.name: resource_opened
events.when: User clicks through to an external resource.

events.name: source_link_clicked
events.when: User opens a source citation.

events.name: share_clicked
events.when: User uses the Share button (native share or copy link).

events.name: playbook_step_viewed
events.when: A playbook step enters the viewport for >=2 s (once per step per page load).
events.purpose: Where people drop off. Not a completion claim.

events.name: playbook_checklist_completed
events.when: All items in the on-page completion checklist are ticked (state is in-memory only).

events.name: correction_submitted
events.when: Correction API returns success.

events.name: error_shown
events.when: A user-visible error state renders.

events.name: theme_changed
events.when: User changes theme manually.

events.name: identity_selected
events.when: An identity is chosen in the picker, from an example chip or the browse page.

props.sector: sector slug, or 'life_role' for sensitive life roles (person-with-a-disability, newcomer-to-a-country, family-carer, parent-of-a-disabled-child)

events.purpose: Which sectors arrive; never the identity itself (18 §10).

events.name: need_chip_selected
events.when: A need chip is chosen on home or an identity page.

events.name: lens_viewed
events.when: A lens page or identity×tool page renders.

events.name: module_marked_done
events.when: A learner ticks 'I can do this' (stored on device only).

events.name: toolkit_shared
events.when: Share/print/copy on a toolkit card or 'explain this to someone'.

events.name: helping_mode_toggled
events.when: 'I'm helping someone else' switched on.
events.purpose: How often people use the site on behalf of others.

events.name: identity_no_match
events.when: The identity picker shows no match for a typed query (after fuzzy and alias matching) and the visitor leaves or submits.
events.purpose: Missing-profession discovery for the admin (20 §3). Shown in the admin report only when the same query occurs at least 3 times, so one person's typing is never visible.

events.name: explore_mode_changed
events.when: Visitor switches the 'Explore by' entry point.

events.name: skill_selected
events.when: Visitor opens a skill page or picks a skill in autocomplete.

events.name: suggest_edit_opened
events.when: Visitor opens the Suggest an edit sheet (S36).
events.purpose: How often people want to help, by page type.

events.name: whats_new_viewed
events.when: S37 viewed.

events.name: helper_started
events.when: A visitor starts a helper (S40 Start button or S39 card).

events.name: helper_stage_completed
events.when: The last 'done' item of a stage is ticked.
events.purpose: Where people finish and where they stall.

events.name: helper_panel_opened
events.when: The S41 panel sheet is expanded.
events.purpose: Whether the panel is useful on other pages.

events.name: helper_shared
events.when: Share or print is used on a helper (S40/S41).
events.purpose: Whether helpers spread to friends and family.

events.name: goal_opened
events.when: A goal page (S43) is opened.
events.purpose: Which goals people actually need; feeds trending only for consenting signed-in users.

events.name: goal_search
events.when: A goal search returns results or none.
events.purpose: Zero-result goal searches become new goals (research queue).

events.name: alternative_opened
events.when: A tool is opened from the 'Other ways to do this' strip (S43/tool page).
events.purpose: Are alternatives useful, and which rank gets chosen.

events.name: intent_selected
events.when: A visitor taps Compete, Grow or Scale on the home page (S01-R).

events.name: star_toggled
events.when: An item is starred or unstarred.

events.name: signin_prompt_shown
events.when: The sign-in moment (S44) is shown.

events.name: signin_completed
events.when: A visitor completes sign-in.
events.purpose: Sign-in conversion per trigger; consent rate for trending.

events.name: signin_dismissed
events.when: The sign-in moment is dismissed.

events.name: recommendation_shown
events.when: A recommendation card is shown (S01-R, S45).

events.name: recommendation_clicked
events.when: A recommendation card is opened.
events.purpose: Click-through per rule; the only tuning input for D-080.

events.name: recommendation_dismissed
events.when: 'Not for me' or 'I already know this' is tapped.

events.name: trending_opened
events.when: The trending list (S47) or a trending card is opened.

events.name: outcome_reported
events.when: 'What changed for you?' is answered (FR-085).
events.purpose: The real success measure: did the person gain an edge.

events.name: stage_output_saved
events.when: A stage output (note or link) is saved (FR-084).
events.purpose: Do helper stages produce something real.

events.name: suggestion_status_viewed
events.when: A suggestion status page (S48) is opened.
events.purpose: Does closing the loop bring contributors back.

events.name: continue_card_clicked
events.when: The 'Continue where you left off' card is used.
events.purpose: Return behaviour: the core retention loop.

events.name: profile_exported
events.when: A signed-in user downloads their data.

events.name: account_deleted
events.when: A signed-in user deletes their account.
events.purpose: Why people leave (count only; no identifier).

events.name: kit_opened
events.when: A kit page is opened.

events.name: kit_step_opened
events.when: A kit step is opened.
events.purpose: Where people drop off inside a kit.

events.name: safety_panel_expanded
events.when: The red-flag list on a safety panel is expanded.

events.name: profile_preview_opened
events.when: The 'what is unchecked' list on a Preview label is opened.
events.purpose: Which tools people want verified first.

events.name: goal_search_no_kit
events.when: A natural-language goal search returned no kit and no goal.
events.purpose: Which outcomes need a new kit. Same redaction as search_submitted.

events.name: suggestion_card_clicked
events.when: A card in Suggested for you is clicked.
events.purpose: Which rule helps. Count only; no identifier.

events.name: next_step_click
events.when: The NextStepCard action is clicked.

events.name: learn_tool_click
events.when: 'Learn {tool}' is clicked.
events.purpose: Which tools people want to learn and at what depth.

events.name: need_feedback
events.when: A need card gets a thumbs up or down.
events.purpose: Curating identity to need maps (D-102). Anonymous.

events.name: helper_coach_dismiss
events.when: The helper coach mark is dismissed.
events.purpose: Whether the helper bar is understood (D-100).

events.name: helper_hide
events.when: The helper bar is hidden.
events.purpose: Whether the bar is in the way.

events.name: role_path_request
events.when: 'Ask for my job' on a general guide.
events.purpose: Which role paths to write first (D-094).

events.name: role_suggest_open
events.when: 'Suggest my role' is opened.
